_doc: Pip, imp courier of the Ashen Court: decrees from Duchess Malphine, camp gossip, comic relief. Pool 'pip'. Malphine only speaks through Pip's letters.

lines.text: Oi! Oi! You are the new Sinbound! I am Pip. Courier to the Ashen Court.
I carry decrees, gossip and, once, a duke's spare head. Do not ask about the head.
Duchess Malphine says welcome. Also: go and die gloriously. Also: do not track ash on her carpets.

choices.text: Tell the Duchess I said thank you.
Tell the Duchess to come up and fight.

lines.label: thanks
lines.text: Ooh, polite. She will hate that. She thinks manners are a sign of weakness.

lines.label: fight
lines.text: Hee! I am not telling her that. I like my ears where they are.
Decree from the Court! Ahem. Ahem!
The Sinbound shall bring down the Herald of the Last Dawn, for the glory of the Pit and the warmth of its nobility.
There is a bit more, in smaller writing.
Soon, please. It is getting very cold down here.
You did it! The Herald! The Court threw a feast!
I was not invited. I was the feast. Only a little bit. I grew back.
Gossip! Grimmaul talks to his anvil when he thinks nobody is looking. He calls it Darling.
You did not hear it from me. You did not hear anything from me. I am not here.
Did you know the Clerk sleeps standing up, holding his ledger? In case anyone tries to read it.
I tried to read it once. The numbers bit me.
Is it true you used to be an angel? Did you have a harp? Can I have it?
I melted it into a knife.
...Can I have the knife?
Personal letter from the Duchess! For you! She never writes personal letters. I am shaking.
Sinbound. Your successes have been noted. Your successes have also been noticed. Those are different things.
Be a good weapon and do not start thinking for yourself. Weapons that think tend to get melted down.
...She signed it with a little heart. A real one. It is still beating.
Is it true? The big chair? Up at the top? Nobody in it?
The Court has gone mad. Three dukes have challenged each other for it already, and one of them is a puddle now.
You had better hurry, {demon}. Someone is going to sit in it. Might as well be someone I like.
You won! You actually won! I bet three toes on you and now I have nine!
Wait. That is not how betting works. Where did the extra toes come from?
Got a decree for you! No, wait. That is my lunch.
Hot today! Well. It is always hot. That is sort of the point.
If you see a duke, I was never here.
The lava is extra bubbly today. That means it likes you. Probably.
You fell out of the Font right on top of me! Twice! Well, once. It felt like twice.
Psst. Psst! I read a letter I was not supposed to read. I read all of them. That is the job, mostly.
When the Sinbound has cleared the Seventh Gate, have it destroyed. The Throne is for the Court, not for our weapons.
So. Um. She is going to kill you. After. I thought you should know. I like you more than her. You have never eaten me.

lines.label: try
lines.text: Hee! Oh, I hope I am there to see it. From a safe distance. A very safe distance.

lines.label: spy
lines.text: A spy! I am a spy now! Do spies get hats? I want a hat.
Wings! Can I sit on your wing? Just once? I am very light!
Morvane! Do you have my name in your book? Is it spelled right? It is P-I-P!
...Hello, Warden. I have been good. Very good. Mostly.
Vharok! Do the roar! Please do the roar!
Ysolde is my favourite. Do not tell the others. She is so QUIET.
Mr Nhazgul! Please do not let them in my ears again. They were in my ears for a week.
Can I ask the flies a question?
They are listening.
...Do you ever get lonely? No. Of course you do not. You are never alone. Hee. I would like that.
Mr Iscariel! Is it true you were an angel AND a demon? At the same time? Which half do you eat with?
Is it true they paid you thirty pieces of light? Can I see one? Just one? I will give it back!
I do not have them, Pip. I never did.
...Oh. Then can I have one of your feathers? The white ones. The black ones are a bit crispy.
